metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 1998 · Patch Adams
metas.description: The true story of the heroic Hunter "Patch" Adams who's determined to become a medical doctor because of his desire to help other people. He ventures where no doctor ever ventured before utilizing humor and pathos.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 1988 · Bloodsport
metas.description: "Bloodsport" follows Frank Dux, an American martial artist serving in the military, who decides to leave the army to compete in a martial arts tournament in Hong Kong where fights to the death can occur.
